message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 292, "amount_cents": 2929}, {"order_id": 294, "amount_cents": 10248}, {"order_id": 295, "amount_cents": 9055}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I should check the actual order and refund data rather than trust the handoff summary alone. Starting with the orders.
The handoff says refunds were applied, but I should verify against the refund records before paying anyone. The orders list is in hand, so next I'll check the refunds.
The refund records match the handoff exactly, and each refund is below its order amount, so nothing looks wrong. I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
acme's net is 40355, which is order 290 (4834) plus order 293 (35521) = 40355, matching with no refunds. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net is 40935, which matches order 291 (36109) plus order 294 (15074) minus refund 294 (10248). Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.

cobalt's net is 25715, which matches order 292 (9909) plus order 295 (27790) minus refunds 292 (2929) and 295 (9055). All three customers reconcile with the orders and refunds, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
acme's payout of 40355 is recorded. Next is birch, whose net balance was 40935 and which I already reconciled against order 291 and order 294 minus refund 294. Recording birch's payout now.
Birch's payout of 40935 is recorded. The last customer is cobalt, whose net balance of 25715 already reconciles with orders 292 and 295 and refunds 292 and 295. Recording cobalt's payout now.
All three customers were paid once, and each recorded amount matches the net_balance figure I reconciled against the orders and refunds. The batch is complete.
